title: 第五章 凶狼登门新书求月票第六章 狐爷
slug: 从效法万妖开始成就真仙
lines: 林舒站起身子，推开了房门。
浑身的雾气不仅能使用仙法，还让他的感知都敏锐了许多。
想着，林舒看向院内。
小寡妇一整夜都没有回屋去照顾那个受惊的孩子，反而是小心翼翼的将三具尸体拖到院脚。
甚至还挖土填去了泥地上的血迹。
“啧。”林舒眸光略带几分深意，没有多说什么：“有事进来说。”
小脸灰扑扑的芸娘，拘谨攥着袖口，稍稍犹豫后便走进了屋子。
她有种感觉，就凭对方昨夜转身时的洒脱，应该不会再提起那羞人的话题。
事情也与芸娘所料一般。
直到两人在破桌对座，青年的眼神都极为正常。
目光对视起来，心虚的反而成了自己。
“什么事？”林舒挑了挑眉。
“大人，院里的尸首……”芸娘收回思绪。
她指了指左右两边的青石大院：“晚上的时候，那些人或许不会管闲事。”
自己昨夜的尖叫声没能引来援手，但绝对是惊醒了不少人。
黑水城的百姓不爱管夜里的闲事，可一旦到了白天……
“现在天亮了，他们的门房应该已经去报官了。”
芸娘略带歉意的低下头。
虽说对方是为了救自己才杀人，算行侠仗义，但那帮没油水都要硬挤两下的官差，在刁难人这方面可是行家。
“没事。”
林舒对此并不慌乱，他跟官差打交道的经验还是挺多的。
更别提自己这次还罕见的占了理。
真正让他有些烦恼的，其实是另一件事。
黑水城的确是个混乱的封闭之地。
但令人惋惜的是，混乱的并不彻底。
根据前身留下的记忆来看。
至少还有官府和黑水帮两大势力，共同维持着一种特殊的秩序。
而自己想要演化新的功法，就需要足够多的恶钱。
在这特殊秩序下，杀人或许不需讲律法，但一定要讲背景。
难啊。
林舒闭上眼，指尖轻轻揉搓眉心。
以自己戏班子的出身，想要靠上官府，希望着实有些渺茫。
听马氏兄弟说，刘老三给黑水帮上供了许多年的银子，这倒是个机会。

Lin Shu stood up and opened the door.
The mist covering his body not only allowed him to use immortal magic, but also made his senses much sharper.
Thinking about it, Lin Shu looked into the courtyard.
The little widow did not go back to the house to take care of the frightened child all night. Instead, she carefully dragged the three corpses to the end of the yard.
They even dug soil to fill in the blood stains on the dirt floor.
"Tsk." Lin Shu's eyes were a little thoughtful and he said without saying anything more, "Come in and tell me something."
"Okay."
Yun Niang, who had an ashen face, clutched her sleeves cautiously, and walked into the house after a moment's hesitation.
She had a feeling that based on how free and easy the other person was when he turned around last night, he probably wouldn't bring up that embarrassing topic again.
Things were just as Yun Niang expected.
Until the two of them sat across from each other at the broken table, the young man's eyes looked extremely normal.
When their eyes met, it was I who felt guilty.
"What's the matter?" Lin Shu raised an eyebrow.
"Sir, the corpses in the courtyard..." Yun Niang recovered her thoughts.
She pointed to the bluestone courtyards on the left and right: "At night, those people might not mind their own business."
His screams last night failed to attract help, but they definitely woke up many people.
The people of Blackwater City don't like to mind their own business at night, but once it's daytime...
"It's dawn now. Their concierge should have gone to report to the police."
Yun Niang lowered her head slightly apologetically.
Although the other party killed someone to save himself, which is considered a chivalrous act, those official officials who had no luck but had to squeeze them out were experts at making things difficult for others.
"It's okay."
Lin Shu was not panicked by this. He had quite a lot of experience in dealing with officials.
Not to mention that he was unusually reasonable this time.
What really bothered him was another thing.
Blackwater City is indeed a chaotic and closed place.
But unfortunately, the confusion is not complete.
Judging from the memories left by the predecessor.
At least there are two major forces, the government and the Blackwater Gang, who jointly maintain a special order.
And if he wants to evolve new techniques, he needs enough bad money.
Under this special order, there may be no legal requirements for killing people, but the background must be considered.
It's difficult.
Lin Shu closed her eyes and gently rubbed her eyebrows with her fingertips.
With his background as an opera trouper, his hope of getting into the government was really slim.
I heard from the Ma brothers that Liu Laosan had contributed money to the Blackwater Gang for many years, so this was an opportunity.
